wolfganghud_reset_options_confirm: Are you sure, you want to reset all WolfgangHUD options to their default value?
wolfganghud_skip_titlescreen_desc: Go straight to the main menu without waiting for a key press. Applies from the next game start.
wolfganghud_end_stats_title: All players' stats at mission end (host only)
wolfganghud_waiting_info_title: Show who the start waits for
wolfganghud_press2hold_no_lock_when_driv: Don't lock interaction when in vehicle
wolfganghud_interaction_revive_allow_ful: Pickup Revive on full health, but revives < max
wolfganghud_interaction_revive_block_max: Block Revive pickup on revives = max
wolfganghud_show_killcount_desc: Show the kill counter on this panel.
wolfganghud_killcount_color_desc: Text color of the kill counter.
wolfganghud_show_special_desc: Show how many of the kills were special enemies.
wolfganghud_show_head_desc: Show how many of the kills were headshots.
wolfganghud_player_show_accuracy_desc: Show your shooting accuracy on the player panel.
wolfganghud_show_client_ping_desc: Show the ping of each teammate on their panel.
wolfganghud_interaction_show_reload_time: Show a progress indicator while reloading.
wolfganghud_interaction_show_melee_charg: Show a progress indicator while charging a melee attack.
wolfganghud_interaction_show_bar_desc: Show the progress bar of interactions.
wolfganghud_interaction_show_timer_desc: Show the remaining interaction time as a number.
wolfganghud_interaction_timer_hide_motio: Hide the motion dot while the timer is shown.
wolfganghud_interaction_timer_offset_x_d: Horizontal offset of the timer from the screen center.
wolfganghud_interaction_timer_offset_y_d: Vertical offset of the timer from the screen center.
wolfganghud_interaction_timer_color_star: Timer color at the start of an interaction. It fades into the end color.
wolfganghud_interaction_timer_color_desc: Timer color at the end of an interaction.
wolfganghud_hudlist_show_desc: Show the HUD list (enemies, objectives, loot, pickups) at the right screen edge.
wolfganghud_hudlist_box_bg_color_desc: Background color of the list entries.
wolfganghud_hudlist_progress_alpha_right: Opacity of the progress indicators in the list.
wolfganghud_hudlist_show_enemies_desc: Show a counter of the currently spawned enemies.
wolfganghud_hudlist_specialcolor_desc: Color of the special enemy counter.
wolfganghud_hudlist_show_objectives_desc: Show a counter of important target enemies, such as generals.
wolfganghud_hudlist_objectivecolor_desc: Color of the objective enemy counter.
wolfganghud_hudlist_show_loot_desc: Show a counter of heavy objects (carryable loot).
wolfganghud_hudlist_show_valuables_desc: Show a counter of valuable pickups.
wolfganghud_hudlist_use_dogtag_values_de: Count dogtags by their actual value instead of as single items.
wolfganghud_hudlist_show_equipment_desc: Show a counter of mission equipment pickups.
wolfganghud_hudlist_show_pickups_mode_de: Show no combat pickups, only revive packs, or all pickups (ammo, health, grenades).
wolfganghud_hudlist_pickupcolor_revives_: Color of the revive pickup counter.
wolfganghud_hudlist_pickupcolor_desc: Color of the other pickup counters.
wolfganghud_use_fhb_desc: Show floating health bars over enemies.
wolfganghud_fhb_alpha_desc: Maximum opacity of the health bars.
wolfganghud_fhb_custom_pie_color_desc: Use your own colors for the health pie instead of the default ones.
wolfganghud_fhb_color_start_desc: Color of the health value at full health. The pie uses it too, unless custom pie colors are set.
wolfganghud_fhb_color_end_desc: Color of the health value at low health. The pie uses it too, unless custom pie colors are set.
wolfganghud_fhb_show_friendly_desc: Also show health bars over friendly units.
wolfganghud_dmgpopups_display_mode_desc: Off, only your own hits, or the hits of all players and bots (colored by the shooter).
wolfganghud_dmgpopups_skull_align_desc: Place the skull left or right of the damage number.
wolfganghud_dmgpopups_time_desc: How long a popup stays visible, in seconds.
wolfganghud_dmgpopups_height_desc: Height of the popup above the target.
wolfganghud_dmgpopups_color_desc: Color of normal hits. Only used in the Player mode.
wolfganghud_dmgpopups_critical_color_des: Color of critical hits. Only used in the Player mode.
wolfganghud_dmgpopups_headshot_color_des: Color of headshots. Only used in the Player mode.
wolfganghud_dmgpopups_custom_ai_color_us: Use a separate color for damage dealt by bots. Only used in the All mode.
wolfganghud_dmgpopups_custom_ai_color_de: Color of damage dealt by bots. Only used in the All mode.
wolfganghud_suspicion_show_detected_text: Show a text once you are fully detected. Needs the PD2-style indicator.
wolfganghud_suspicion_show_ring_bg_desc: Show the background of the suspicion ring.
wolfganghud_suspicion_show_percentage_nu: Show the suspicion as a number in percent.
wolfganghud_suspicion_percentage_color_s: Color at low suspicion. It fades into the end color.
wolfganghud_waypoints_show_pickups_desc: Show waypoints on pickups (ammo, health, grenades).
wolfganghud_waypoints_pickups_offset_des: Height of the waypoint above the pickup.
wolfganghud_waypoints_pickups_angle_desc: Waypoints are only shown within this angle around your view direction.
wolfganghud_waypoints_pickups_distance_d: Maximum distance at which pickup waypoints are shown.
wolfganghud_waypoints_pickups_hide_unint: Hide the waypoint while the pickup cannot be taken.
wolfganghud_waypoints_show_pickups_reviv: Also show waypoints on revive packs.
wolfganghud_waypoints_revives_color_desc: Color of the revive pack waypoints.
wolfganghud_waypoints_loot_icon_desc: Show an icon on the loot waypoints.
wolfganghud_waypoints_loot_offset_desc: Height of the waypoint above the loot.
wolfganghud_waypoints_loot_angle_desc: Waypoints are only shown within this angle around your view direction.
wolfganghud_waypoints_loot_distance_desc: Maximum distance at which loot waypoints are shown.
wolfganghud_hud_layout_desc: Layout of the player and teammate panels.
wolfganghud_colorize_names_desc: Color player names by their character color.
wolfganghud_hud_colorize_mode_desc: How name colors are assigned: synced with the outline colors, or by panel position.
wolfganghud_levels_before_name_desc: Show the player level in front of the name.
wolfganghud_hide_in_camp_desc: Hide kill counters, accuracy and the HUD list while in camp.
wolfganghud_chat_own_left_desc: Show your own messages on the left side too.
wolfganghud_chat_colorize_desc: Color chat names like the HUD names.
wolfganghud_chat_colored_bg_desc: Use the player color as message background.
wolfganghud_chat_name_spacing_desc: Spacing between the name and the message.
wolfganghud_chat_hide_delay_desc: Seconds until the chat fades out. 0 keeps it visible.
wolfganghud_chat_messages_kept_desc: Number of chat messages kept in the history.
wolfganghud_skip_intro_desc: Skip the intro videos when the game starts. Applies from the next game start.
wolfganghud_streamline_menu_desc: Use the same size for all main menu entries.
wolfganghud_add_join_menu_offline_desc: Add the servers entry to the camp menu in offline mode.
wolfganghud_waiting_info_desc: Show which players the mission start is waiting for.
wolfganghud_ready_on_num_enter_desc: Ready up by pressing Num-Enter on the ready-up screen.
wolfganghud_mark_stealthables_desc: Mark in the mission list whether a mission can be played stealthily.
wolfganghud_show_hidden_weapon_stats_des: Show weapon stats that the vanilla interface hides.
wolfganghud_show_weapon_stat_diff_desc: Show the difference to your equipped weapon in the weapon stats.
wolfganghud_fix_skill_preview_desc: Fix the wrong stat preview when hovering weapon upgrade skills.
wolfganghud_convert_sizes_meters_desc: Show the alert size of weapons (noise radius) in meters.
wolfganghud_fov_based_sensivity_desc: Adapt the mouse sensitivity to the zoom (FOV) while aiming.
wolfganghud_auto_reload_desc: Automatically reload automatic and burst weapons when you pull the trigger on an empty magazine.
wolfganghud_auto_reload_single_desc: Automatically reload single-shot weapons when you pull the trigger on an empty magazine.
wolfganghud_realistic_reload_desc: The bullets left in the magazine are lost when you reload.
wolfganghud_press2hold_min_timer_duratio: Minimum interaction time in seconds for the lock to activate.
wolfganghud_press2hold_show_lockindicato: Show an indicator while the interaction is locked.
wolfganghud_press2hold_interrupt_hint_de: Show a hint on how to interrupt a locked interaction.
wolfganghud_press2hold_no_lock_when_driv: Do not lock interactions while in a vehicle.
wolfganghud_kick_a_friend_desc: As host, kick Steam friends from the lobby without banning them.
wolfganghud_instant_restart_desc: As host, restart the mission or return to camp without the vote delay.
wolfganghud_restart_hotkey_desc: Key to restart the current mission. Only works in a mission, and as host or in singleplayer.
wolfganghud_sound_mute_toasts_desc: Mute the sound of mission notifications.
wolfganghud_restart_required: Requires a restart to the main menu.
wolfganghud_hudlist_seperate_specials_de: Show a separate counter for each enemy type instead of one combined counter.
wolfganghud_press2hold_equipment_cancel_: Use the equipment key instead of the interact key to cancel an active interaction.
wolfganghud_press2hold_lock_mode_desc: Lets you release the key during long interactions. Progress: once you held it for the minimum time. Total: if the interaction takes at least the minimum time.
wolfganghud_chat_scrollbar_desc: Show a slim scroll bar next to the chat messages when there is more history to scroll: off, left or right.
wolfganghud_end_stats_desc: At the end of a mission, show each player's kills, special kills, headshots, accuracy, downs and revives. Off, only for you, or posted to the chat for everyone.
wolfganghud_fhb_margin_desc: Spacing between the health pie and the health value.
wolfganghud_interaction_turrets_stealth_: In stealth, using a turret needs a quick double-tap of the interact key, so you don't start it by accident.
wolfganghud_interaction_revive_allow_ful: Allows picking up a revive pack at full health, as long as you are below the maximum number of revives.
wolfganghud_interaction_revive_block_max: Blocks picking up a revive pack and hides its prompt when you already have the maximum number of revives.
